datasets.name: sqad-3.2-test
notes: Czech QA. Corpus is every distinct context across all three splits; gold is the context cut around the question's answer sentence.
Contexts are reconstructed windows of whole sentences (cut_window), since 3.2 ships whole articles. Yes/no golds are mapped to ano and ne.
Answers are short spans, so EM is a meaningful metric; a generator that writes a sentence around the span will lose EM and keep F1.
